findings.title: Kernel Exploit Registry Vulnerabilities Detected
findings.description: 4 kernel vulnerabilities matched running kernel version 7.0.12-linuxkit: CVE-2026-46331 (pedit COW), CVE-2026-53362 (IPv6 fraggap out-of-bounds write), CVE-2026-64564 (SCTPhantom SCTP ASCONF transport UAF), and CVE-2026-53361 (BadGarbage AF_UNIX garbage-collector race).
findings.extraction_notes: Grouped kernel exploit registry matches into a single finding per Rule 4. Inferred team Data from explicit app-ownership reference data_app_2.
